issues.description: In the Kakuro exercise template the state_preparation method uses the parameter name 'ancilla_register' while the constructor and the rest of the file (and the problem description) use 'auxiliary_register'. The solution implementation uses 'auxiliary_register'. This parameter-name mismatch between the template and the solution/problem statement is structural and may confuse students when they try to follow patterns from other methods in the same file (e.g., passing the instance's auxiliary register into state_preparation).
issues.suggestedFix: Rename the parameter in the template's state_preparation signature from 'ancilla_register' to 'auxiliary_register' to match the constructor, other methods, the solution, and the problem statement. Update any internal references in the template method body/comments to use the consistent name 'auxiliary_register'.

issues.description: The template implementation for the Kakuro exercise uses the parameter name ancilla_register in the state_preparation() signature, while the rest of the template and the problem statement consistently use auxiliary_register (and the solution also uses auxiliary_register). This inconsistent identifier for the same conceptual entity (the auxiliary/ancilla qubit register) can confuse students when mapping the problem requirements to the template code and when comparing with the reference solution.
issues.suggestedFix: Use a single consistent name for the auxiliary register across artifacts. Rename the parameter ancilla_register in the template's state_preparation() signature to auxiliary_register (and update any internal references) so it matches the rest of the template, the problem statement, and the solution. Alternatively, if preferring 'ancilla_register', update the problem statement and all other template/solution references to use that name consistently.
